SELECT pot.id, pph.name as phaseName, pot.name AS taskName, pot.charge_name, pot.plan_start_time AS planStartDate, pot.plan_end_time AS planEndDate, pot.reality_start_time AS realityStartDate, pot.reality_end_time AS realityEndDate, pot.status AS taskState FROM project_task pot LEFT JOIN project_phase pph on pot.phase_id = pph.id AND pph.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_plan pp ON pp.product_id = pot.product_id AND pp.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pot.is_deleted = FALSE
AND pot.product_id IN
#{id}
AND pot.name ILIKE concat('%', #{params.taskName}::text, '%')
AND pot.status = 4
AND pot.status <> 4
AND pot.plan_end_time >= #{params.thisWeekDateList[0]} AND (#{params.thisWeekDateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > pot.plan_end_time
ORDER BY pph.name, pot.plan_end_time, pot.create_time
